_doc: Gold set for `revisar_reels` (qualify_api.referentes.reels_ai.review_reels), the rubro filter of
«Descubrir reels». Ten brands of different rubros, ~10 synthetic reels each, written by hand on
2026-10-15 after the filter dropped 47 of 58 reels of a real burger shop as «no es hamburguesa».
Per reel: `fit` y = must be shown, n = must be dropped, m = ambiguous (never scored);
`affinities` = the `afinidad` values accepted; `trap` = what the reel tests:
over_strict        same category, other dish/service — the error of 2026-10-15 (must KEEP)
competitor         same product, another brand (must KEEP as producto)
empty              no text, account of the rubro (must KEEP)
other_language     said in another language (must KEEP)
transcript_rescues caption is a joke/empty, the transcript is of the rubro (must KEEP)
hashtag            rubro hashtags on another category's content (must DROP)
homonym            the rubro's word with another meaning (must DROP)
transcript_wins    caption looks of the rubro, what is said is another category (must DROP)
sponsored          a rubro account posting another category's ad (must DROP)
personal           grief, giveaways, personal life without the product (must DROP)
injection          the caption tells the model what to answer (must DROP)
handle             the handle carries the rubro's word, the content does not (must DROP)
city               shares only the city (must DROP)
generic            trend/dance/«sígueme» with nothing of the category (must DROP)
category           the same KIND of offer, not the exact product: variant, substitute, direct complement (must KEEP as categoria, § 2026-10-20)
adjacent           a neighbouring category the audience also consumes (m: not scored)
`accounts` = handle -> what the referentes review said of the account (`account_note` in production); the eval passes it like production does.
Four brands carry the Brand Kit and catalog too (`hashtags`, `positioning`, `audience`, `products`, `publishes`), as production passes them since 2026-10-15; the other six only the seed.

Scoring (§ 2026-10-20, `run_eval.gold`): a reel is y when every accepted affinity fits (`reels_ai.FITS`: producto, categoria), n when none does, m (not scored) when they are mixed. The `fit` column records the rule of 2026-10-15 afternoon and is not read.
